sample_unit: complete questionnaire responses (1,075 question-answer interactions; 389 individually rated responses)

links.outcome: Expert-rated answer quality of OsteoCHAT versus general-purpose LLMs on ten FAQs
links.effect: Median total scores 14/15 for Gemini, ChatGPT, and OsteoCHAT and 13/15 for Meta AI; quality comparable to general-purpose LLMs.
links.quote: Blinded expert benchmarking showed acceptable-to-high-quality responses across all LLMs (median total scores 14/15 for Gemini, ChatGPT, and OsteoCHAT and 13/15 for Meta AI), with expert-identified weaknesses mainly concerning pharmacological treatment indication and communication of adverse and rare safety-critical events.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented grounding in a national clinical guideline for a patient-facing chatbot, assessed by user acceptability and expert-rated quality

screen.reason: Multicenter prospective patient evaluation and expert benchmarking of OsteoCHAT, a guideline-grounded retrieval-augmented generation chatbot compared with general-purpose LLMs.
